svg.text: When vLLM calls the Platform hooks
vllm serve, TP = 2 (worker processes) · numbers give the order · each process has its own current_platform
config hooks run in the front end, and again in the engine core · component pickers run where the component is built
Which hook runs where, and in which order?
Steps 1-7 shape the VllmConfig. Steps 8-17 repeat in each process that needs the part.
the uni executor runs steps 11, 13-15 inside the engine core process (uniproc_executor.py:68-75); step 12 does not run (one rank).
Not shown: import_kernels (when vllm._custom_ops is imported), get_punica_wrapper (LoRA only),
compile pickers (get_pass_manager_cls, get_static_graph_wrapper_cls, get_compile_backend) and log_warnings.
Order inside the worker: init_worker (11), init_device (12), load_model (13-14), then step 15 (multiproc_executor.py:672-702).
